verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication product (to-dos, message boards, chat, calendar, card tables). It does not author or host git commits, so signing AI-authored commits with SSH or GPG keys is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Basecamp producing commits; its AI-agent and MCP support covers project data, not source control.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
